integrity: All 121 tetrahedra are embedded. Integral first homology is independently proved from the graph-cycle presentation by an exact determinant and mod-five rank argument. Every three-vertex clique is exhaustively classified and evaluated in exact homology coordinates.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns simple edge cycles in one fixed eighteen-vertex proper simplicial triangulation of the Weeks manifold. It does not compare geometric hyperbolic length, pseudo-simplicial triangulations, or other proper triangulations.
title: Every nonzero first-homology class has a triangular systole in the eighteen-vertex Weeks manifold
